content: Claude Code headless: 'claude -p/--print PROMPT --output-format json|stream-json'. json output includes result, session_id, total_cost_usd. Resume via '--resume <session_id>' (capture session_id from prior json). stream-json is NDJSON events starting with system/init. Permissions via --allowedTools / --permission-mode; --dangerously-skip-permissions for full automation. Copilot CLI: 'copilot -p PROMPT --allow-all-tools' (or --allow-tool 'shell(pytest)'), --no-ask-user, --model. Hermes: 'hermes chat -q' / '--oneshot' non-interactive print mode, no PTY needed.
